title: Solar Charger 10 W MPPT – Maintenance Charger for 12 V
seo_title: Solar Charger 10 W MPPT – Maintenance for 12 V Battery
seo_description: Solar charger 10 W, MPPT maintenance charger for 12 V battery. With cigarette lighter cable, cable with battery clamps, 4 suction cups and manual.
descriptionHtml:
The second before you turn the key after winter

The battery in the caravan, the boat or the ATV discharges on its own month after month while the vehicle sits still, and you don't know if it's enough until you actually try to start. Plugging in a regular charger every week feels like too much work for a vehicle that just sits there anyway.

A solar panel that keeps the battery alive

The charger is a 10 W MPPT maintenance charger for 12 V systems. The solar panel is connected to the battery with either the cigarette lighter cable or the cable with battery clamps, and is attached with the 4 suction cups. A manual is included.

Features

  • The battery is maintained while the vehicle sits still – the solar panel is a 10 W MPPT charger for 12 V systems.
  • Connects the way that suits the vehicle – includes both a cable with a cigarette lighter plug and a cable with battery clamps.
  • Attaches without drilling – the panel holds with the help of 4 suction cups.
  • Everything you need is in the pack – solar panel, two cables, 4 suction cups and manual.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
